args.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a finished, high fidelity full-scroll desktop website design for Lyra Radio. Requested canvas EXACTLY 1920 x 5000 pixels, portrait aspect 0.384 (height 2.604 times width). This is one single long desktop webpage, not a presentation board and not mobile screens. Show the entire page from header through footer. Use crisp readable live-looking text and a real 1920px desktop composition, 96px outer gutters, roughly 1728px usable width. Match the inspected brand reference: Barlow Condensed 700/800 display, Space Grotesk reading, original graffiti wordmark, original anime street-radio art treatment. Brand board is IDENTITY reference only: IMPORTANT replace its historical cream background with cool concrete #f3f4f6. Ink #17191c, acid #d7ff3f, cobalt #3b4fd8, orange #ff7144. Clean flat UI surfaces, purposeful print-like borders, readable type, upright buttons. Strong editorial hierarchy, substantial art with full focal subjects, generous but intentional rhythm, varied sections. Avoid turning every section into a repeated card grid. The before screenshot is content/behavior reference ONLY; improve its sparse layout substantially.
Truthful product: self-hosted local music library with artist/genre-seeded personal radio queues, metadata-and-lyrics semantic search using optional local EmbeddingGemma, editable timed lyrics from local Whistle, daily recommendations from recorded listening. No real FM broadcast, listener counts, fake testimonials, pricing, streaming catalogue, community, or claims that the model hears mood. Any small illustrative UI content must have an explicit visible caption “Illustrative library”. Header: Lyra logo, Features, Self-host, Log in. Footer: Lyra, Features, Self-host, GitHub. Large hero campaign lettering can use uppercase; keep all other headings sentence case. All text at sensible desktop size, body around24px on1920 canvas, no tiny caption spam. Buttons are purposeful and upright. Do not watermark or add annotations outside the page.
PAGE: Main home landing, “Own your frequency.”
STRUCTURE TOP TO BOTTOM, fully compose all:
1. Simple cool-gray header then a large edge-to-edge acid rooftop hero occupying about900px total including header. Use the attached rooftop DJ artwork: the same dark-haired anime male with orange headphones and lime jacket seated on giant blue/orange speaker on RIGHT, generous negative space LEFT. Hero headline left “Own your frequency.” in extremely bold condensed type, around150px, three short lines. Supporting copy “Your collection. Your station. A new way to get lost in the music you keep.” Primary black “Create an account ↗”, secondary “See how it works”.
2. Ink strip with three balanced text pairs: “Your music / Albums, artists and playlists”, “Your station / Built from your library”, “Your next discovery / Follow a new connection”.
3. Cool-gray spacious editorial section “The records you kept. / The station you make.” Intro left and a row of three richly illustrated genre station sleeve tiles right, original anime graffiti scenes, named “After hours”, “Concrete rhythm”, “Open sky”. Caption Illustrative library. Underneath, compact explanatory copy and link “Explore the features →”. This is visual explanation, no fake player data or charts.
4. A full-width ink section, strong 45/55 split. Left large white title “Find the track / you can’t name.” Short paragraph about searching descriptions using metadata and available lyrics, acid link. Right a large crisp static search UI surface cool gray, input text “late-night city drive”, three result rows with colored tiny artwork, invented names “Neon side streets”, “Last train home”, “Blue hour”. Caption “Illustrative library · Semantic search”. Keep it genuinely readable and restrained.
5. Orange and cool-gray editorial split “Keep the words close.” Show a generous simple lyric panel with 3 short original lines, selected center line emphasized, a single integrated waveform seekbar and play button; no analytics. Supporting text explains local transcription, timing and edits. A cobalt narrow supporting band below says “A fresh route through your collection, every day.” with restrained copy about 24-hour recommendations and recent recorded plays.
6. Cool-gray “From folder to first play.” Three large numbered steps in horizontal editorial columns separated by fine rules: “Connect your music”, “Make it your own”, “Press play”. Brief meaningful copy, link to self-host setup.
7. Native FAQ style three full-width ruled disclosures: “Is this an online radio broadcast?”, “Do I need an API key?”, “Can I use music I already own?” with first answer visibly open. Large generous readable text, no boxed card treatment.
8. Large acid final CTA band “Good music. Your rules.” left and “Create an account ↗” right. Footer simple clean rule and brand.
Aim refined magazine pacing: dense enough to feel finished but never wall-of-text. Preserve proportion of all eight sections so whole page fills requested5000px.

exportMethod: Aspect-preserving contain resize, cool-gray padding if needed. Untouched original retained; no crop or nonuniform stretch.
